title: Construct a Binary Tree from Preorder and Postorder Traversals
problemStatement: Given the preorder traversal and postorder traversal of a full binary tree containing unique values, reconstruct the original binary tree.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the preorder traversal. • The third line contains the postorder traversal.
output: • Print the reconstructed tree in the required traversal format.
constraints: • 0 ≤ N ≤ 2 × 10^5 • The binary tree is full. • All node values are unique.________________________________________
